exposure: interventions for prolonged second stage of labor
cohort: Singleton gestations at term, diagnosed with prolonged second stage of labor and head station of S + 1 and lower
finding: In deliveries complicated by prolonged second stage, cesarean delivery was associated with poorer neonatal outcome than vacuum assisted delivery, but there was no significant difference in traumatic outcomes between the two groups.
mod_finding: In cases of prolonged second stage of labor, cesarean delivery is associated with poorer neonatal outcomes compared to vacuum-assisted delivery.
